description: This file contains a PHP class 'Returns' which extends the system's base model class and provides methods to fetch and compute returns data from the database for the OpenCart admin reporting extension.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving return data and statistics within the OpenCart admin report extension.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of returns based on filtering criteria such as date range, return status, and grouping interval.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Calculates the total number of returns, optionally grouped by day, week, month, or year.
